title: Reborn, I Ditched the Faithless Crown Prince
synopsis: After Eastin Crown Princess Julia is reborn, she refuses the unfaithful Crown Prince and allies with Prince James to outwit palace rivals and powerful ministers. Together, they expose treacherous schemes, leading to the Crown Prince's downfall and the destruction of the Baldwins. Julia and James safeguard their homeland, finding fulfillment amidst ordinary joys and pledging to stand by each other in the next lifetime.
intro: Crown Princess Julia of Eastin gets a second life and makes a different choice: she refuses the unfaithful Crown Prince. It reads like a palace drama novel, now on screen: Julia allies with Prince James, outwits palace rivals and powerful ministers, and exposes their treacherous schemes. The story follows the Crown Prince's downfall, the end of the Baldwins, and a quieter happiness for the two who protect their homeland together.
why: A rebirth story where the heroine uses what she knows to rewrite her fate.
Palace scheming, ministers and rivals, with a partner who stands by her.
Good pick if you like royal dramas with both revenge and a steady romance.

faq.q: Is Reborn, I Ditched the Faithless Crown Prince worth watching?
faq.a: If you enjoy palace intrigue and second-chance heroines, yes. It mixes court schemes with a romance that ends on a promise for the next lifetime.
Julia, the reborn Crown Princess of Eastin; Prince James, her ally; and the unfaithful Crown Prince she refuses this time.
